hypothesis: Stable semantic identity plus targeted acknowledgements, one active lease, monotonic fencing, current spec revision checks, and idempotent receipt keys reduce duplicate and stale work under retry/loss/crash conditions.
counterhypothesis: Current append-only work events plus mandatory refresh/revalidation are sufficient and the additional coordination state adds no net benefit.

repo_gap.observation: Several open UnifiedDB EAP dispatch issues use repeated dispatch surfaces. This is evidence of retry/re-dispatch possibility, not proof of duplicate benchmark execution.

Apache Kafka idempotent producer and transactional fencing/recovery concepts
limitations: Synthetic parameters are assumptions, not production measurements.

No current Work Event v1 replacement or canonical promotion is authorized.
Real transport amplification, SQLite contention, restart behavior and concurrent-worker behavior remain unmeasured.

lease expiry and old-holder late commit

promotion_rule: Candidate remains additive shadow research only until matched Ubuntu differential and recovery tests show net benefit without authority or semantic regression. NO_BENEFIT, KEEP_ISOLATED and REFUTED are valid outcomes.
